answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent economy can mandate max-flow trust routing across a peer-attestation graph. Nodes establish bounded credit channels that bend like a willow under dynamic transaction loads. Adversaries incur the scarce relational cost of acquiring genuine inbound trust edges from honest peers to reach an operational summit. However, honest newcomers face harsh onboarding delays, and trust drains away if bridge nodes connect to an adversary's karst of synthetic identities.
